description: CPU, memory and other resources of a valkey container.

limits.description: Maximum amount of each resource the container can use, keyed by resource name (for example `cpu`, `memory` or `nvidia.com/gpu`).

requests.description: Minimum amount of each resource the container needs, keyed by resource name (for example `cpu`, `memory` or `nvidia.com/gpu`).

name.description: Name of the claim the container uses.

request.description: Name of the request within the claim. Uses every request of the claim when unset.

claims.description: Dynamic resource claims of the container.
